scenes.line: Milo planned a little parade through the garden.
Pip promised to be the parade's cheerful drummer.
They practiced one gentle beat together.
Then Milo's bright red ball bounced away.
It vanished behind the tall flower bush.
Milo searched the path, but found only leaves.
Pip listened carefully beside the flowers.
A soft tap answered from somewhere nearby.
The friends paused and listened once more.
A tiny firefly glowed above the grass.
Then another light blinked near the bush.
Pip followed their twinkling trail slowly.
Milo tiptoed behind his brave little friend.
The fireflies gathered near one bright red spot.
There was the ball, tucked beside a root.
Pip nudged it gently back to Milo.
Milo smiled and thanked Pip for listening.
The fireflies shimmered like tiny parade lights.
Pip tapped a happy rhythm on the ball.
Milo hopped along the garden path.
The friends marched beneath the evening flowers.
Every firefly seemed to dance along.
They learned that patient listening can help.
And their tiny parade reached home together.
